subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add opt-in all-message Space ingestion through user OAuth, Google Workspace Events, or neither?
rationale: The remaining request changes credential storage, OAuth/event scopes, data visibility for non-mentioned Space messages, subscription lifecycle, and operator consent, which source review cannot safely decide.

options.title: Approve Plugin-Owned OAuth/Events Design
options.body: Define a Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events contract with SecretRef/redaction support, explicit scopes, docs, and opt-in all-message ingestion.

options.title: Limit Google Chat To Mentioned Webhooks
options.body: Keep the bundled plugin service-account and mention-triggered, and close or narrow all-message ingestion as out of scope after thread work is resolved.

options.title: Defer To Broader Workspace Auth
options.body: Wait for a shared Google Workspace auth/events model before adding this channel-specific data-ingestion surface.

recommendation.title: Approve Plugin-Owned OAuth/Events Design
recommendation.body: Define a Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events contract with SecretRef/redaction support, explicit scopes, docs, and opt-in all-message ingestion.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate from prior Google Chat OAuth/security review context.
